stories.title: Skubal shines, tears up in emotional Detroit return
stories.summary: Dodgers lefty Tarik Skubal threw six strong innings and was brought to tears in his return to Comerica Park on Friday night, acknowledging it was difficult to treat it as just another start.

stories.title: Clark, Mitchell drop dual 34-point nights in rout
stories.summary: Caitlin Clark and Kelsey Mitchell dominated the action for the Fever on Friday night, lighting up the Sun with 34 points apiece in a 111-91 rout.

stories.title: LaFleur: 'Fully anticipate' Jacobs being on Packers
stories.summary: Green Bay Packers coach Matt LaFleur addressed Josh Jacobs' future with the team Friday, one day after Jacobs was charged with two misdemeanors related to an alleged incident earlier this year with a woman at his home.
